def.brief: Bounded non-author review of the uncommitted 2.0.0 metadata and README diff by a fresh Claude sub-agent: the five version values against README Versioning / Release and adoption and AGENTS.md, the timeless README edits read against the code they describe, and docs consistency; read-only.

non-claims: no check decides this task; done means the agent said so
v2-review: done on the session's word by name (`run v2-review`), with nothing of its own in the tree and no `did`
v2-review: done by the session's sub-agent — chongdae saw the session and the tree, not the sub-agent; its model is the session's unless the session dispatched it with another

trace.command-lines: kept in the local session transcript, not in the record
